newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-GERMAN BOLTS WINS DAUPHINE LIBERE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-GERMAN BOLTS WINS DAUPHINE LIBERE.

text.p: Udo Bolts of Germany won the Dauphine Libere cycling race on Sunday, making up a deficit of one minute and nine seconds to beat overnight leader Abraham Olano of Spain into second place by 12 seconds.

Andrei Teteriuk of Kazakhstan won the seventh and last stage over 182 km from Briancon as Olano, seeking a third successive Spanish win after Miguel Indurain in 1995 and 1996, suffered a fall, a puncture and technical problems in the final hour.
